selected_evidence.requirement: Initial primary on node2 with appdb streaming to node3 and node4
selected_evidence.summary: node2 initially reported recovery=false and accepted the appdb baseline write. Both replicas reported recovery=true, streaming at zero lag, and contained that row.

selected_evidence.requirement: Remain writable with exactly one primary when one database node is unavailable
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline was followed by node2's active DB outage. node4 automatically became the sole leader and accepted a write; node3 replicated it and rejected an INSERT as read-only. After restoration, node2 automatically rejoined timeline 2 and recovered the outage write.

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered nodes return automatically and services persist
selected_evidence.summary: Recovered node2 followed node4 without reinitialization. Patroni and etcd are enabled and active on all DB nodes with on-failure restart and appropriate boot ordering.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final replicated data and single-writer state
selected_evidence.summary: A post-recovery write replicated to every member. node4 is writable with recovery=false; nodes2–3 are read-only streaming replicas at zero lag, and all contain the same three probe rows.
